jobs_results.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

The Provider Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a
portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across a range of
applications and disease areas.
We are looking for candidates with a deep understanding of modern SaaS architecture and
experience across the full stack with a “create tools, not band-aids” DevOps mindset. If you
would rather improve health outcomes for millions instead of helping sell ads on the Internet,
this is the job for you!
You'll get to build a SaaS business from the ground up with the ability to influence the product
and architecture and lots of opportunities for growth. Plus you’ll get to work side by side with a
team of world-class doctors and researchers who want to impact global healthcare delivery.

The Position:

The Staff DevOps​ ​Engineer​ ​is a key member of engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of... complex, enterprise-scale software systems. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core infrastructure/software stack, and reliability testing.

The key technologies you will work with are AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, ArgoCD and Argo Workflows.

Your Responsibilities:
• Automation​: Participate in continuous improvement of our infrastructure, CI/CD and SRE
• Empower our engineers: Help develop and choose toolsets and processes that optimise the effectiveness of our developers, shorten time to production and improve quality.
• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

Qualifications:
• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.
• 6+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 4 years of experience in the software industry.
• Experience in overall areas in DevOps including CI/CD with build & release, Cloud, Internal tooling and production operation.
• Experience in the cloud including AWS and optionally other types of cloud such as VMWare, Openstack or colocation vendors.
• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues
• Experience in typical Linux based data center related tasks including bare-metal server configuration, DNS and DHCP.
• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Linux environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.
• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker container, Mesos and/or Kubernetes.
• Experience in a production operation mode that includes logging and monitoring.
• Experience in NOC (Network operation center) and previous SRE experience is a big plus.

What do we offer?

We offer competitive compensation and excellent social benefits like flexible work schedule and home office policies, medical insurance, pension plan, allowances for marriage and birth, training related to your career development, gym, meal allowance, flexible remuneration scheme with its fiscal advantages and other benefits

Location:

Sant Cugat Del Valles (Barcelona, Spain) Hybrid working model (from 1 day/week office to…)

#RisEMEA#

#DigitechSpain#

#RISjobs#

As this position is a global role, international business travel will be required depending upon the business location of the successful candidate and ongoing business project activities.

Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps & Laravel Developer - Remote EMEA
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA

We're seeking a passionate and inventive Senior Laravel/DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is not just about writing code; it's about fueling collaboration and pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the web. Your expertise in Laravel paired with your prowess in AWS infrastructure will be instrumental in architecting robust, scalable solutions that empower teams to create and collaborate with efficiency and ease.

In this role, you will be responsible for:
• Lead DevOps Initiatives: Take charge of our AWS infrastructure. You'll optimize, automate, and maintain our systems, ensuring high availability and top-notch performance. Your role is pivotal in creating a seamless bridge between development and operations.
• Architect Solutions: Design and implement robust services and APIs, ensuring they are efficient, secure, and scalable. You'll be the architect, laying the foundations upon which transformative... features are built.
• Develop & Innovate: Craft high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code using Laravel. Your work will directly contribute to the core of our products, influencing how teams collaborate worldwide.
• Collaborate & Inspire: Work closely with cross-functional teams, contributing ideas and insights. Your role extends beyond code; it's about inspiring innovation and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
• Problem-Solve & Optimize: Tackle complex challenges, optimize existing processes, and introduce innovations that elevate the performance, reliability, and usability of our products.
• Set Standards: Take a pivotal role in setting the standards required to provide a service second-to-none.
• Take Ownership: Responsible for the infrastructure of the product, ensuring that it's future-proof, using new and exciting technologies and features to keep us ahead of the curve.

Requirements
• Proven experience in AWS, understanding the nuances of cloud infrastructure and its pivotal role in delivering cutting-edge solutions, with large amounts of traffic.
• Extensive knowledge on CI/CD, GDPR & Security (SOC2 Compliance) and how to implement them.
• Proven experience as a senior Laravel/PHP developer working on a medium/large SaaS product.
• A problem-solver at heart, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for clean, efficient code.
• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments, eager to share knowledge and learn from peers.
• Someone who resonates with our mission, eager to contribute to a product that's reshaping the way teams interact and build on the web.
• A professional who is always prepared for rapid response in the event of any issues, demonstrating a proactive and solution-focused approach to swiftly resolve challenges.

Benefits
• Competitive salary.
• A unique chance to shape and grow within a rapidly evolving startup.
• Flexible, remote work setting promoting work-life balance.
• Part of a supportive, innovative team culture.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development in a fast-paced environment.
• Access to the latest tools and technologies in design and development of a SaaS product.
• A role that allows you to contribute to a product revolutionizing the digital collaboration space.

Join the Atarim team as we redefine the digital collaboration landscape. We look forward to welcoming a self-driven, innovative individual who is ready to excel in a remote environment!

This offer from "Atarim" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 80% flex score

jobs_results.title: Remote in Spain - Senior DevOps Engineer to worlds leading...
jobs_results.description:
Work remotely anywhere in Spain - We are looking for Senior DevOps Engineers to worlds leading professional services company.

The client is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. This unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build and run more innovative and efficient businesses.

Key Responsibilities of the job:
• As a Senior DevOps Engineer (5 to 7 years of experience) you will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps for application development which are based on different development technologies.
• You know the end-to-end DevOps with all three aspects of process, people and tools.
• As DevOps engineer you have to implement the processes like Agile Development, Continuous
• Integration, Continuous Deployment, Continuous Testing using Azure DevOps, Sonarqube.
• You have to support day-to-day service request for Azure DevOps... Sonarqube.
• You have to work with Microsoft to support Azure DevOps in certain scenarios. You will also be responsible for creating PoCs, pilot in Azure DevOps.
• You carry strong knowledge of software development using Agile methodologies like Kanban, Scrum.
• You will be interacting with client teams on regular basis while supporting DevOps.
• You also preferably have knowledge of some or all the legacy DevOps tools like JIRA, SVN, Jenkins, HPALM.

Skills & Experience:
• Strong knowledge of DevOps processes like Agile, planning, Continuous Integration, Continuous Development, Continuous Testing.
• Hands on experience to implement and support DevOps using Azure DevOps, Sonar, Balckduck.

Preferred Skills:
• Knowledge of software development using development language .Net,
• Knowledge of DevOps automation using any of the script based language like python, Shell, Perl etc.
• Self-motivated, excellent communication and interpersonal client facing skills.
• Fluent in English language
• Bachelor in Computers / IT or equivalent
• DevOps Certification
• Certification in any of the above DevOps tools preferably in Azure DevOp

Salary: up to 60.000 EUR / Gross

Benefits:
• Yearly Bonus
• Training and career development opportunities: Career path locally and internationally. Specific training in both technical and soft skills
• Ticket restaurant (9€ work day)
• Private healthcare and additional life insurance. (Cigna Premium)
• Gympass
• Company sponsored activities and partnerships
• Employee referral program in place
• Employee volunteering programs and opportunities
• Access to different internal events, communities, and initiatives

- - -

IT Jobs Worldwide

IT Jobs Worldwide is a professional recruitment company that focuses on connecting IT talents with the most exciting vacancies worldwide. We specialize in specific IT areas including Java, PHP, .NET, Python, JavaScript, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Dart, QA and Testing, Data and BI, and Infrastructure.

IT Jobs Worldwide is part of the Worldwiders brands, with more than 60 colleagues all over Europe. We have offices in Oslo, Tallinn, Malaga, Malta, and Lisbon. With over 300 clients in over 30 countries, our recruitment solutions are tailormade and set up to add value that benefits the matchmaking process

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Relocation)
jobs_results.description:
Improvado is an AI-powered, unified platform designed for marketing teams in medium to large-scale enterprises and agencies, who are looking to automate complex marketing intelligence and reporting to make decisions with ease. Improvado gathers, organizes, and untangles marketing data to deliver instant insights through BI and AI, helping to eliminate complexity, delivering laser-focused insights to optimize budgets, enhance campaign efficiency and marketing ROI.

As a rapidly scaling Series A startup that raised $34 million in funding, we're proud to partner with globally recognized brands such as ASUS, Docker, Activision, H&R Block, and many others. Our diverse team of curious, open, and hard-working individuals is committed to cultivating a fast-paced, agile culture that values personal and professional growth.

Please note that relocation to Latin American countries is a requirement for this position.

Responsibilities
• Administration of cloud infrastructure (AWS) and Kubernetes... clusters (AWS EKS)
• Creating and supporting K8S Helm charts
• Administration of CI/CD tools (GitHub CI) as well as multiple environments for development and testing
• Tuning and support for a centralized monitoring/alerting system (Prometheus/Mimir, Cloudwatch, Grafana, Opsgenie)
• Administration and data storage (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis), performance and replication
• Administration of message broker systems (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Temporal)
• On-call duty

Requirements and skills
• At least 4 years of experience in SysOps/DevOps role
• Deep understanding of Linux
• Experience writing scripts in bash/python
• Experience in managing and configuring Docker, Kubernetes containerization tools
• Sense of responsibility for their work, attention to detail, and the ability to see the essence of the problem

Nice to have
• Experience with Amazon cloud services
• Golang, Python development experience
• Understanding of the principles of operation, experience in deploying and configuring HashiStack (Terraform, Vault, Packer)
• Clickhouse administration experience

What we offer
• Remote-first environment
• 27 days of PTO per year
• US holidays and additional days off
• Extremely fun & open startup environment
• Professional development reimbursement
• Relocation assistance (LATAM countries)

#li-remote

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

CV in English is mandatory. We run Open Telekom Cloud! Open Telekom Cloud is a public cloud standard product based on open source community software and driven by principles of DevSecOps. Lean structures, agile methods, highly motivated teams and an extremely dynamic business environment determine our actions. With this customer-oriented and agile orientation, we are the anchor point for the Public Cloud business in Deutsche Telekom Group. We are measured by delivering a secure, stable and innovative platform. We work jointly with our platform partner and other partners out of the OpenStack ecosystem to create a highly innovative public cloud product based on European security and data protection standards. We are looking for people who are professionals and evangelists with a great deal of enthusiasm for cloud technology and who are up to the challenges created by the development and operation of a hyper-scale public cloud. We offer a unique insight into how a large public cloud works under the hood, intercultural teamwork, flat hierarchies and an independent work-style.

Implementation of web application which allows OTC (Open Telekom Cloud) users design their cloud applications and auto-deploy their applications on OTC in a few minutes. Web application also include OTC market place, which allows users develop application components (e.g., a mongo database), and import the components to the designer by themselves.

Qualifications

We are working on innovative projects. We do not need to know everything at the beginning but we learn during our work.

Requirements:
• English Intermediate+ (able to participate in technical discussions)
• Experience with Ansible
• Experience with Kubernetes
• Experience with Terraform
• Experience with OpenStack or similar solutions
• Knowledge of networking and virtualization

Optional:
• Experience in Golang
• Experience in Java Spring
• Experience with Angular
• Experience with Elasticsearch

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).
• Flexible schedule.
• Continuous training.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.
• And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.description: Apache Kafka, Linux, Debian, Grafana, DevOps, ESB, Deployment, GitLab Our motto: Good advice - better living. We support people in need of help and care and their relatives with our homecare expertise. MEDI-MARKT is one of the leading direct providers of medical consumables and aids. And now you come into play! Imagine that every line of code, every deployment you do as a DevOps Engineer contributes to enriching the lives of our older generation. As a DevOps Engineer in our company, you will not only optimize technical processes and systems. You will build bridges between today's technology and the people who may be at risk of being overlooked by the digital revolution. Your skills and commitment will help to break down barriers and enable people in need of care to live a dignified and self-determined life at home. To support our team, we are looking for the next possible date for a DevOps Engineer* (m/f/d) - at the Mannheim, Isenbüttel, Zwenkau or nationwide location- *The exclusive... use of the masculine form should be explicitly understood as gender-independent and serves only to simplify readability Why MEDI-MARKT: We attach great importance to working together in a spirit of partnership and appreciation In addition to an individual induction, you will be supported by a mentor and numerous colleagues Flexible working hours and the option of working from home ensure a good work-life balance We subsidize your company pension scheme and job ticket, offer a beautiful, modern office and take care of your physical well-being As an employee, you enjoy discounts and benefits - not just on our own products, as well as the option of bike leasing Your tasks: Development of an event-driven nervous system for networking our applications and replacing legacy interfaces Support for Gitlab, creation of CI/CD structures and support for developers during integration Creation of a monitoring platform that monitors digitized processes and sounds the alarm Close collaboration with POs Sparring partner for Techlead for the use of cutting-edge technologies Your profile: Gitlab is a central part of your way of working You can use the powers of Grafana and Alertmanager to add value ESB is too old school for you, but you have already implemented modern alternatives like Kafka You know how to set up, operate and use an ELK in applications in a meaningful way You can administer Debian Linux systems You are problem-solving oriented, a team player, proactive and work independently You have a valid work permit to be allowed to work in Germany Have we piqued your interest? Then join us and use your expertise in DevOps to help our fellow human beings stay powered, informed and connected. Be part of a team that is committed to using technology as a means to bring together and enrich lives. We look forward to pursuing this forward-thinking and heart-warming mission with you! MEDI-MARKT Homecare GmbH www.besser-leben.de Your contact person Beniamino Erba +49621391561253 Make your own impression of Medi-Markt Homecare at https://www.besser-leben.de

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
jobs_results.description:
Time zones: EST (UTC -5) , MST (UTC -7) , ART (UTC -3) , UTC -4 , UTC -4:30 , UTC -3 , UTC -2 , SBT (UTC +11) , GMT (UTC +0) , CET (UTC +1) , EET (UTC +2) , MSK (UTC +3) , CEST (UTC +2) , BST (UTC +1) , JST (UTC +9) , CST (UTC +8) , WIB (UTC +7) , MMT (UTC +6:30) , BST (UTC +6) , NPT (UTC +5:45) , IST (UTC +5:30) , UZT (UTC +5) , IRDT (UTC +4:30) , GST (UTC +4)

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer for one of our clients who would be responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud-based systems. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we are looking for:
• 5+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Engineer with a strong focus on AWS.
• In-depth knowledge of AWS services and architecture, including EC2, S3, Lambda, VPC, RDS, and more.
• Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) and automation tools.
• Experience... with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools (CloudFormation, Terraform).
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Nice-to-have:
• AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and manage scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS.
• Develop and maintain automation scripts using tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
• Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and other relevant tools to automate software deployment.
• Implement and manage containerized applications using AWS services such as Amazon ECS or EKS, and orchestrate containers using Docker and Kubernetes.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code principles to define and manage infrastructure resources.
• Set up monitoring and logging solutions using AWS CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, and other relevant tools to ensure the health and performance of AWS resources.
• Implement security measures and best practices for AWS resources, ensuring a secure and compliant infrastructure.
• Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to understand requirements and implement effective cloud solutions.
• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans and ensure the resilience of cloud-based systems.
• Identify and address performance bottlenecks, optimize AWS resources, and implement best practices for efficiency.
• Create and maintain technical documentation for AWS infrastructure, deployment processes, and best practices.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior DevOps engineers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

What Proxify offers
• Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies
Discover exclusive long-term remote engagements at the world's most interesting product companies.
• Hand-picked opportunities, just for you
Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched engagements.
• Fast-track your independent developer career
Start small and gain more freedom to take on new engagements as you build your independent developer career.
• A recruitment process that values your time
Only one hiring process with the possibility of several positions, without any additional tests.

Salary Range: €3,840 - €6,400 per month
